'''Shaldme '''is the eleventh month in the [[Farede calendar]]. In most years, it is equivalent to the real world period from [[September]] [[September 29|29]] to [[October]] [[October 26|26]].  [[Amaetheon]] occurs on the 6th and [[Shaoman]] on the 12th.
